records.notes: All natural grass-fed highland beef. Holistically raised from start to finish at 8,000 ft. in Colorado. Established in 1959.

Land health is at the core of the mission at Badger Creek Ranch. The family owned and operated working ranch is managed mindfully with respect and love for the relationship between people, land, animals and the ancestors of the land they steward. The offerings are grass fed and finished beef and lamb, pork, chicken and eggs. The hogs, chickens and turkeys are fed certified organic, non-soy feed and they enjoy living outside on the land. On-line ordering can be found on the website. Produce can be picked up at the farm store in Coaldale, or at the Salida, Buena Vista and Cañon City farmer’s markets.

Cottonwood Spirit Ranch is a working Ranch and Airbnb.We offer a verity of local goods including Beef,Eggs,produce and Honey!!!Our beef is grass fed, USD inspected and organic. The veggies are fresh from the garden. The honey is all wild flower,raw and unfiltered!
Family owned and operated fifth generation historic cattle ranch producing 100% grassfed beef. No hormones or antibiotics. Find us on Facebook @everettranchbeef.

Looking for local beef! We are as local as it gets! Our Family has been raising quality grass fed beef in Chaffee County for 7 generations! You can see our beautiful herd of Red Angus cross cattle right along hwy 50 between Salida and Poncha Springs, we are the only green pastures left in this corridor of development. We handle each animal humanly from birth to butcher we are the single owner of the animal. All beef is 100% grass fed and all natural. We pride ourselves on providing an outstanding product so you know where your meat comes from. We love our cows, you will love our beef. Please call if you’d like a tour to come visit the ranch and learn more about our operation.

Lewis Ranch cows have been raised in the Arkansas Valley for 30 years. Our cows graze on public and private land between Poncha Springs and Leadville year round. We offer grass fat beef by the half in the fall and grass fed burger year round. All our beef is processed locally and USDA inspected. Contact Kate or Brice by phone, email, or Facebook at Lewis Lazy L Ranch. We are also happy to provide beef delivery on larger orders and ranch tours by appointment!
Whole, half, and quarters of locally raised grass and grain finished beef. Seasonal availability.

We are a small, family-run meat market, open since 1952. It is a USDA-inspected wholesale and retail meat market with beef, pork, lamb, buffalo, poultry, sausage, deli meats & cheeses, seafood, fish, smoked & cured items, and lots more! Many Italian products are available as well. We pride ourselves on a small business atmosphere that is very clean with great competitive pricing. We also offer slaughter and processing services for beef, pork, lamb, and buffalo! Find us on Facebook at @SCANGAMEATCO

Purveyors of the finest Colorado High Altitude Wildflower Honey. Raising Happy Hens for Eggs and Meat. Offering Organic Layer Feeds at the farm. Coming next fall, Grass fed beef on regerative pastures. Call or Email. Or find us at Salida Farmer’s Market.

records.products: Beef/Meat, Dairy, Poultry/Eggs, Spices/Garlic, Veggies, Staples
records.notes: Valley Roots Food Hub is a local food aggregator and distributor based in Mosca, CO, and serving much of our great state of Colorado including Chaffee County! We serve individual customers at home looking for grocery shopping needs, as well as grocers, restaurants, caterers, buying clubs, schools, food banks, & more! Customers can enjoy up to 100+ producers from our network all on one invoice. We are open year-round with a Monday 4 PM order deadline & Thursday delivery. We also have convenient pick-up locations available. Individuals at home can participate by shopping with us each week, picking and choosing what they’d like in each order. We also have our multi-farm CSA Fresh Box program where customers pay for their share upfront and for 13 weeks in the summer, our team curates what goes in each box.
Goatmilk herd shares available. $50 per month entitles you to 1 gallon fresh raw goats milk per week.

A family farm and the first commercial lavender farm in South Central Colorado, discover quality lavender skin, bath, and culinary products made at the farm. Grown naturally at 7000 feet elevation, our lavender makes excellent essential oil that is incorporated into our products. You can trust the source and visit the farm in the summer to see our lavender fields up close. With over 13 different lavender cultivars at the farm and offering plant starts in early summer, learn about lavender and its wonderful benefits. Our shop features all of our products and delicious lavender blackberry ice cream. We offer most of our products year-round on our website too. We are dog-friendly (leash please). The serenity and peace of the farm, with a mix of lavender and fresh mountain air, keep visitors coming back year after year.
We are a farm located in the Rocky Mountains of Colorado, growing fresh produce, flower fields and a pumpkin patch. We aim to interconnect nature and humanity through agriculture.
Moonstone Farm is owned and operated by Jen Visitacion in Salida. Jen runs a small CSA and buyers club and offers on farm events & workshops, a farm-stay in the historic barn turned retreat cottage.

We are a sustainable flower farmer and wedding and event florist in Salida. We offer summer flower subscriptions, wedding and event services, holiday arrangements, and some herbal products. We hope to offer classes and workshops in the future. We are a family farm and open by appointment.

We are a 3-acre specialty cut flower and produce farm located in Buena Vista, Colorado at 8,000 ft. Women owned and operated since 2013. Trout Creek Farm is dedicated to sustainable food production in the upper Arkansas River Valley. We are here to provide food and flowers for our community, keep the land healthy and farmers happy.

Copper Kettle Apothecary is a true herbal apothecary with a selection of over 400 medicinal herbs, teas and cooking spices sold in bulk. Feel free to bring a jar to be filled or we can use a paper bag supplied in store. Also available are prepacked herbal supplements, botanical body care products and naturalistic themed gifts and homewares, books, candles, and sometimes houseplants. We are fully prepared to serve every one interested in traditional remedies from the person having their first cup of herbal tea to the sixty year herbal practitioner. Consultations are available for anyone needing more guidance.

We operate a small farm in Buena Vista. All the produce we grow is pesticide free and sustainably grown. We offer an 18-week vegetable CSA (first week of June through beginning of October) with pick-up options in Buena Vista and Salida. Large and small CSA shares are available. Email or call us and we will send you more details.

Growing gourmet garlic in Salida, Rocky Mountain Garlic specializes in hard neck Garlic as well as Shallots and Onions. Last season, we experimented with many different root crops and are expanding into other hardy vegetables. We are offering “shares” for purchase! Please contact us for more information and to sign up. We — Mike and Tiffany Collette — grow following organic and biodynamic processes, using an earth-friendly mentality. Our garlic is tended by hand, one clove at a time, on land that is free of chemicals. We place much importance on minimal tillage using mulches, manures, and cover crops in order to hold nutrients and rejuvenate the soil. We use drip irrigation to conserve water and bring to market a unique crop of high desert garlic. From seed to harvest to storage, our garlic is grown for you and good for you. Our mission is to provide fresh and local food, grown by people you can meet face-to-face. It is the heritage of our country and we are proud to continue the tradition!

Get involved in growing produce, relationships, and community! At Salida’s not-for-profit Colorado Farm to Table (CFTT) we grow approximately 10 acres of fresh produce for distribution to Coloradans in need. Starting in 2022, we are going to have a separate 1 acre plot of fresh vegetables to sell at the farmers market with all proceeds going back to our donation farm. The summer of 2022 will be our 26th season, CFTT has been welcoming people of all backgrounds in volunteer farming experiences to grow top-quality, nutritious produce for hungry families. Volunteer farm hands work with the farmer in 3-hour shifts. No experience is necessary – instruction and tools are provided. Join us! It’s a lot of fun and a great opportunity to meet and network with some awesome people. CFTT’s sustainably grown produce is distributed via partner nonprofit food pantries, soup kitchens, low-income housing, and feeding programs that redistribute the freshly harvested produce onto the plates of those most in need of nutrition relief. We encourage and welcome new volunteers, distribution partners, and innovative collaborative partnerships. Contact info@coloradofarmtotable.org for more information!

Guidestone Colorado is a Chaffee County-based, 501c3 nonprofit dedicated to growing a vibrant agricultural future through education, community building and partnerships. We serve our local community and the statewide agriculture community through our four cornerstone programs: Farm to School, Farmhands Education, Colorado Land Link, and the Hutchinson Homestead & Learning Center. The Farm to School Program fosters garden education at two school gardens and the Community & School Farm, and grows produce for Salida School District, ensuring access to local produce in school meals. Guidestone’s food production activities also include growing food for the Heart of the Rockies Regional Medical Center, supporting area CSAs and community members in growing and purchasing local food, and working with community partners on food distribution. Guidestone’s additional food system work in Chaffee County includes implementing and participating in the Chaffee Local Food Coalition, partnering with City of Salida on their Community Garden Program, and serving as a partner on several regional food system collaborations.

Mushroom Love Co is a gourmet mushroom farm located right here in the high rockies! We provide oyster and lions mane mushrooms for restaurants, markets and individuals. We also have mushroom growing supplies and classes available.

We are a small family farm focusing on microgreens. We also grow seasonal produce from our veggie plot on our homestead in progress. We also produce garden starts, potted herbs and indoor house plants. We offer a weekly farmstand newsletter for easy ordering and offer on farm pickup and delivery within the Poncha springs and Salida limits. We have lots of information about microgreens, our farm and easy ordering instructions on our website.

The mission is open to provide food and meet client needs from 11am to 2pm every Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday, or by appointment. All of our services are FREE and CONFIDENTIAL and include the following: Groceries/Client Pantry Employment Resources Health Care References Prescription Co-pay Assistance Fuel Vouchers for Emergencies | Listed offerings: Providing food from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday, or by appointment.

Sanctuary Soup Kitchen The Sanctuary Soup Kitchen provides a hot meal from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. Tuesday and Thursdays and a Food Pantry on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. The Soup Kitchen is also a common space used for human service programs. We partner with Sol Vista, the Chaffee County DMV, and several Christian Churches to meet basic emotional, spiritual and physical needs. | Listed offerings: Meals Offered on Tuesday and Thursdays from 11:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m. and a Food Pantry Tuesdays & Thursdays from 11;00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m.

We strive to fill in the gaps where other public programs are limited or unable to assist. Chaffee Cares works closely with and accepts referrals and applications from third party professionals that work directly with local children, adults, seniors, and families in Chaffee County. Using a simple application process and the direction of the board, we strive to quickly help those in need and are dedicated to a 24 hour turnaround time in most situations. To apply fill out an application at https://www.chaffeecares.org/application. Thank you!

Thanks to generous donations from Safeway and other local businesses, we have a limited supply of food available on a daily basis. This is generally given out as needed, on a first-come-first-served basis. We also have some food held in reserve to help out families in emergency situations. Hours are from 10:00 am – 1:00 pm Monday to Friday.
Offering a full range of wood-fired cuisine. Our beef is locally raised from Arrowpoint Cattle Company. During the summer season, we have locally grown greens.

Foodshed Alliance facilitates a thriving local food economy by organizing and promoting Farmers Markets and Vendors. We manage the Farmers Markets in Buena Vista and Salida, Colorado and host ShedFest, a hyper-local, end-of-the-season celebration of the region’s talents and bounty.

At Salida Community Fridge, we believe that abundance is a human right. Thanks to all of our growers and eaters who help to make that dream a reality in our small community! Open 24/7 for all. | Listed offerings: Guidestone Colorado’s Free Community Fridge, Always Available 24/7, Behind A Church, 419 D St

By Appointment & 2SLGBTQIA+ Friendly Pantry on 10 a.m. – 4 p.m. Tuesdays – Fridays PIFCA’s pantry is a community-supported space ensuring everyone has access to nourishing food and vital Health & Beauty Aids (HBA). We are especially dedicated to supporting those facing food insecurity and acknowledge the disproportionately high rates of houselessness and food insecurity faced by our LGBTQ+ siblings, particularly our Trans community, due to systemic barriers. Our entrance is in the basement. Head down the stairs to the left of the Starpoint Community Center’s main front entrance; you’ll see the rainbow mural as you descend. If you need handicap accessible entry, we’re happy to meet you upstairs in the Starpoint Community Center – just let us know when you arrive! | Listed offerings: 2SLGBTQIA+ Friendly Pantry 10 am - 4 pm Tuesdays - Fridays

The Salida Senior Citizens, Inc. dba Salida Community Center distributes food on the first Wednesday of each month. Income requirements are followed. We ask that people stay in their cars and line up starting at Alpine Park. We start distribution around 10:00 a.m. and continue until noon or 1:00 p.m. Our food is provided to us by Care and Share Food Bank from Colorado Springs and the food selection contains meat, veggies, produce, bread and sweets. We also provide food to the youth of the area. At this time we are handing out and delivering food every Thursday to the youth in the area. Our other food program is the Community Corner Food Pantry. We received a grant in order to purchase food from local organizations and we hand out food from 10:00 a.m. until 2:00 p.m. at 305 F. Street. This program will only be continuing until the end of June.

First Presbyterian Church Food Pantry distributes meals each Monday at 12:00pm, and offers a food pantry on Thursdays from 1:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m. We issue food according to the size of your family. Boxes of assorted food, bread, vegetables (when available), assorted types of frozen meat, and many other items when available. We ask you to drive up in our 3rd Street parking lot and we come out to meet you and serve you and your family.

The Asian Palate celebrates 10 years of our family owned and operated restaurant in downtown Buena Vista, CO, and moves forward with a new concept as a market & catering company. Our ongoing mission is to support local producers, farmers and ranchers as we prepare rotating dishes inspired by family recipes and comfort food discovered while traveling throughout Asia. We offer prepared food, specialty Asian and local goods and art to take home from our marketplace, and a catering menu for any occasion. We are committed to sourcing sustainable fish from around the world for our sushi. Our unique event space awaits your special gathering!
We are a need-based service. Anyone that walks through our door with a hunger need will be taken care of. Food Pantry on Fridays, 10 am – 3:30 pm.

records.notes: At the Lettucehead, you’ll find all of your grocery and health needs. We sell a wide variety of organic food, produce, supplements, and gifts. At affordable prices, we aim to make a healthy lifestyle accessible to all. We focus on Colorado grown food to provide locally sourced, quality products that lift up our community. We are here to support your health journey – whether you’re trying a new vitamin regiment, navigating food allergies, or looking to increase your home cooking. Or perhaps you just need to grab eggs and milk on your way home – we are here for you! For our visitors to Buena Vista, stop by the Lettucehead to stock up on nutritious snacks to fuel your trip! Pick up some jerky and Buena Kist dried fruit for the trails and reward your day of rafting with some cheese from Buena Vista’s own Jumpin’ Good Goat Dairy.

SOIL Sangre de Cristo supports farmers, ranchers and food producers throughout the South-Central region of Colorado by providing NO Interest loans. This support keeps the local food economy resilient, encouraging diversity. SOIL Sangre de Cristo's funds come from community members who contribute to a revolving loan fund becoming investors in the non-profit organization.
